{{Quote|Made with the florets of a Cassius tree. It's good for your health.|[[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]|<ref name="Eminence" />}}
A blend of '''tea''' could be brewed from the [[Flower/Legends|florets]] of the [[Cassius tree/Legends|cassius tree]]. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era [[Secret Mandalore|leader]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], enjoyed cassius [[Tea/Legends|tea]], and believed drinking it was good for one's health.<ref name="Eminence" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Vizsla and his Death Watch [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were encamped on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]]. There, they shared a bottle of cassius tea with the renegade [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], while discussing plans to form an alliance against the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Eminence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tea made from cassius florets was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the young reader novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and published [[January 1]], [[2013]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> Shortly thereafter, cassius tea appeared in the fourteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]], "[[Eminence (episode)|Eminence]]."<ref name="Eminence" />
